text:
alex: planning to push v2.3.1 canary to eu-west-1 at 22:00 UTC. leaving this thread for quick sanity + rollback criteria. @maria smoke, @sam rollback owner, @jen oncall. will be ~30m canary then promote if all green.

maria: ack. i'll run smoke checklist and post results here. quick Q: any DB migration in this canary?

alex: no schema changes. one background job change (job concurrency). no manual migrations.

maria: cool. my smoke checklist (condensed):
- hit /health and /v2/ping (expect 200 and body {ok:true})
- run sample generate and confirm token cost within 10% of baseline
- run small load: `hey loadtest --rps 10 --duration 60 --target /v2/generate` and watch p95
- verify logs for errors: `rlog query "ERROR" --since 30m --service inference`
- confirm metrics: latency p95, error-rate, cpu/gpu util
will paste outputs. :thumbsup:

sam: rollback criteria from my side:
- error-rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR
- p95 latency degrades > 300ms above canary baseline for 5m OR
- KV cache warm failure (cache misses > baseline by 30%) OR
- left-over job backlog > 2x normal for 10m
If any of the above tripped, we initiate rollback. Rollback command (dry-run below):
```
rdeploy rollback --service inference --to-tag v2.3.0 --reason "canary alert"
```
I'll be watching and will initiate if needed. also added a manual quick rollback doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollback

jen: i'll keep oncall channel open and unmute critical alerts. If you want me to silence noisy noncritical alerts during the canary, say now.

paul: please also ensure feature-flag `jobs_concurrency_v2` is set to `off` as a safety net. if we need to limit rollout we can flip it.

alex: leaving ff on for canary (enabled for 5% by default). if metrics look flaky we flip to 0% and promote rollback.

maria: starting smoke now (will post each check). first: /health ok. /v2/ping ok. sample generate fine, returned 120 tokens.

maria: loadtest 60s RPS10 p95=210ms, baseline p95=180ms -> +30ms (within threshold). no errors in logs.

maria: metrics: error-rate 0.1%, cpu 45%, gpu mem stable, cache misses normal.

sam: noted. all green so far. standing by.

devops-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for inference:v2.3.1 started at 2026-03-17T22:00:01Z — canary targets 5% traffic in eu-west-1.

alex: thanks. plan: 30m canary, smoke at 5m and 25m. if both pass, promote. if a single smoke fails or any rollback criteria fires -> rollback.

maria: 25m smoke will include a cold-start test and warm cache test. posting script: ```
# warm cache
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'; sleep 1; done
```

sam: a note on rollback timing: if we need to rollback, try to do it within first 10-15m of rollout while traffic is low to avoid broad user impact. i'll call the rollback and ping ops to coordinate.

jen: oncall will be available. if you hit alerts that match the criteria, escalate to me with `@jen` plus link to this thread.

alex: go/no-go check: maria smoke ok, load ok, sam agrees to rollback rules, oncall ready. i'm calling a tentative GO for canary at 22:00 UTC. final: :eyes: from sam?

sam: GO pending 25m smoke. if anything odd in the interim, i'll call rollback.

maria: will run 25m smoke and report back by 22:25 UTC.

alex: thanks all — i'll start the deploy and update here. remember to post any anomalies as a quick line here (no long threads). :rocket:
